name: nativeloc
description: Native-speaker localization for Android and Linux screen devices

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nativeloc/server" "npm run dev -w @nativeloc/web"
scripts.demo: npm run seed && concurrently -n server,web,kiosk -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @nativeloc/server" "npm run dev -w @nativeloc/web" "npm run dev -w @nativeloc/example-web-kiosk"
scripts.demo:reset: npm run seed:reset && npm run demo
scripts.start: npm run build -w @nativeloc/web && npm run start -w @nativeloc/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/site && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p sdks/js
